name: Front
one_liner: Shared inbox and customer communication platform with a broad Core REST API, webhooks and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Company API tokens (admin created) or OAuth 2.0 authorization-code only (authorize/token at app.frontapp.com). Authorizing OAuth apps requires an admin. OAuth required for public integrations unless Front grants exception.
access_notes: Free 14-day trial with all Professional features, no credit card. Rate limit 50/100/200 rpm by plan (Starter/Pro/Enterprise); increases need Professional+. Partner integrations get a separate 120 rpm.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve via trial and admin-created token or OAuth app; per-customer admin must authorize; low default rate limits; public listing needs OAuth and App Store process.

evidence.quote: Our free 14-day trial offers all the features available in our Professional plan.
By default, Front's API rate limit starts at 50 requests per minute and varies depending on your plan.
End users authorizing OAuth apps must be admins. This applies to both private and public OAuth apps.
